question: Rajeev Taranath, a disciple of Ali Akbar Khan, is a __________ player.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Sarod.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajeev Taranath** (born 17 October 1932) is an **Indian classical musician** who plays the sarod. Taranath is a disciple of Ali Akbar Khan.
 
• He gave his first public vocal performance when he was **nine years old.**
 
• Rajeev was singing for the** ****All India Radio**** before he was twenty.**
 
• He is respected for his **in-depth understanding as he unfolds the raga, the tonal quality and power of his strokes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Distinguished players of the tabla include** ****Alla Rakha**** Khan and his son Zakir Hussain.**
 
• **Hariprasad Chaurasia** (born 1 July 1938) is an** Indian music director and classical flautist, who plays the flute, in the Hindustani classical tradition.****​ **
 
• **Pandit Shivkumar Sharma** (13 January 1938 – 10 May 2022) was **an Indian classical musician and santoor player who is credited with adapting the santoor for Indian classical music.**
